Contributed by Wei-Chiu Chuang. diff --git a/hadoop-common-project/hadoop-common/src/main/java/org/apache/hadoop/io/IOUtils.java b/hadoop-common-project/hadoop-common/src/main/java/org/apache/hadoop/io/IOUtils.java index 2588bf1f465..e6749b76bfa 100644 --- a/hadoop-common-project/hadoop-common/src/main/java/org/apache/hadoop/io/IOUtils.java +++ b/hadoop-common-project/hadoop-common/src/main/java/org/apache/hadoop/io/IOUtils.java @@ -234,7 +234,7 @@ public static void skipFully(InputStream in, long len) throws IOException { } /** - * Close the Closeable objects and ignore any {@link IOException} or + * Close the Closeable objects and ignore any {@link Throwable} or * null pointers. Can be null. @@ -255,7 +255,7 @@ public static void cleanup(Log log, java.io.Closeable... closeables) { } /** - * Closes the stream ignoring {@link IOException}. + * Closes the stream ignoring {@link Throwable}. * Must only be called in cleaning up from exception handlers. * * @param stream the Stream to close -- 2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

**File: IOUtils.java**
1. **Method Documentation Updates**:
   - The JavaDoc for the `cleanup` method was modified to change the phrase "ignore any {@link IOException} or" to "ignore any {@link Throwable} or". This broadens the scope of exceptions that can be ignored during cleanup.
   - The JavaDoc for the `closeStream` method was similarly updated from "ignoring {@link IOException}" to "ignoring {@link Throwable}". This also allows for ignoring a wider range of exceptions when closing streams.

### Relationships
The changes in the JavaDoc for both the `cleanup` and `closeStream` methods are related in that they both aim to clarify that any throwable, not just `IOException`, can be ignored during the execution of these methods. This suggests a design decision to ensure that the code can handle various types of exceptions gracefully during cleanup operations, thereby improving the robustness of the error handling in the codebase.
